name: Snake King
summary: Snake King is a single-player arena snake game developed by Brothers IT and released through kral.games. Players collect food to grow, spend mass to boost and try to make rival snakes collide with their body. Opponents are computer-controlled and marked BOT. Six shrine powers, arena events, a tutorial, death replays, daily missions and achievements accompany unlockable skins and cosmetics. It supports mouse, keyboard, gamepad and touch controls, with local progress saving. The game is free to play in web browsers in English and Turkish. Artwork was created with generative AI and the code was developed with AI assistance.
